profile.title: Academy profile
profile.intro: How your academy appears to tutors browsing vacancies. An administrator approves it before it is shown.
profile.descriptionHint: What you teach, who for, and anything a tutor deciding whether to work with you would want to know.
profile.areaHint: Area is the finest location this platform records. There are no map pins anywhere in it.

status.heading: Approval
status.pending: Waiting for an administrator to review this profile.
status.approved: Approved. Your vacancies are visible to tutors.
status.rejected: Not approved. The reason is below.

vacancies.title: Vacancies
vacancies.intro: Post what you are hiring for. Tutors browse open vacancies and express interest in one action — there is no cover letter and no application form.
vacancies.subject: Subject
vacancies.rateHint: Optional. A vacancy that says negotiable is a real vacancy, and a made-up figure is worse than none.
vacancies.empty: You have not posted a vacancy.
vacancies.emptyBody: A posted vacancy appears on the public board, where tutors can read it and express interest.
vacancies.statusNote: Curriculum, rate and area cannot be edited after posting. A tutor who expressed interest read those terms, and rewriting them underneath her would change what she agreed to look at. Close it and post again instead.

interested.heading: Tutors who expressed interest
interested.body: Their public profile is the record. Contact whoever you want to, in whatever way you normally would — Ustaad.com does not manage hiring beyond this list.
interested.emptyBody: Tutors see this vacancy on the public board. Interest appears here as soon as somebody expresses it.

search.heading: Find tutors
search.body: The same search parents use, with the same verification detail on every result.
